text:
kevin: quick idea — propose we add an "Effective-Identity" header that proxies set when they relay requests so downstream can do correct billing/quotas/console attribution.

sara: curious — why not reuse existing origin headers? attack surface if clients can set it. need signing + verification. :thinking:

omar: agree with @sara. Proposal: proxy attaches header and signs with a KMS key, backend verifies signature against auth service. also we need to bump telemetry sampling for these exchanges.

mia: from console POV we need a clear column: "Used identity" vs "Billing identity". tooltip explaining when fallback happens.

jules: SRE note: be careful about logging org/project IDs in plaintext. Mask in public logs or redact in error traces.

kevin: header format sketch:
```
Effective-Identity: org=org_123;project=proj_456;sa=svc_payroll;sig=base64(sig)
```
Verification flow: proxy signs, backend calls /auth/verify with signature (or verifies locally with cached pubkey).

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 1717501500 :rocket:

telemetry-bot: current sampler: 0.1% for routed exchanges. recommend temporary 5% for first 24h after rollout to capture edge-cases and attribution mismatches.

sara: also need threat model + rotation plan for signing key. who has access? KMS policy must be strict.

kevin: rollout plan (high level):
- behind ff "effective_identity"
- enable for 10% traffic (canary), Dedicated customers only for phase 1
- console column behind same ff
- telemetry sampler -> 5% for 24h, then reassess

omar: quota mapping: prefer billing identity from Effective-Identity. fallback: if header missing or unverified, attribute to caller token (with note in console).

mia: UX: show "inferred" badge when fallback used. include link to troubleshooting doc.

jules: I'll add verifier sidecar + SLO regression tests to staging, and a redaction rule for logs. tagging this as P0 for canary.

sara: +1 — I'll draft the KMS rotation and threat model doc and post in #eng-security once done.

kevin: sweet. @jules can you run the canary next Tue? I'll open PR with header parsing + unit tests for signature verification. :thumbsup:
